parameters.query:
WITH log_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO public.lead_events (
    lead_id,
    event_type,
    event_category,
    workflow_name,
    status,
    payload,
    created_at
  )
  VALUES (
    {{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.lead_id }},
    'consultationstarted',
    'workflow',
    'ConsultationWorkflow',
    'success',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'lead_id', {{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.lead_id }}
    ),
    NOW()
  )
  RETURNING id
),
lead_data AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.id)
    l.id AS internal_lead_id,
    l.external_primary_id,
    l.crm_contact_id,
    l.crm_deal_id,
    l.name,
    l.qualification_summary,
    l.consultation_summary,
    l.lead_status,
    l.source_metadata->>'amo_subdomain' AS subdomain,

    -- Данные для маршрутизации ответа
    ci.external_conversation_id AS reply_chat_id,
    ci.channel AS reply_channel,

    -- Внутренний ID диалога
    c.id AS internal_conv_id

  FROM public.leads l
  LEFT JOIN public.channel_identities ci
    ON l.id = ci.lead_id
  LEFT JOIN public.conversations c
    ON c.lead_id = l.id
   AND c.external_conversation_id = ci.external_conversation_id

  WHERE l.id = {{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.lead_id }}

  ORDER BY l.id, ci.is_primary DESC, ci.id DESC
),
chat_history AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(string_agg(msg, E'\n'), 'История пуста') AS history_text
  FROM (
    SELECT sent_by || ': ' || text AS msg
    FROM public.messages
    WHERE lead_id = {{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.lead_id }}
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 6
  ) sub
)
SELECT * FROM lead_data, chat_history;
